newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open lower.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open lower.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open lower Monday, in line with LME copper prices, after a profit taking rally saw some of last week's sharp gains given back in London.
COMEX July copper was seen opening down 0.50 to 1.00 cents a pound from Friday's close at 119.10 cents, after trading at 114.50 cents in overnight ACCESS trade.
LME warehouse copper stocks fell 200 tonnes to 133,025 tonnes Monday, while COMEX copper stocks fell 200 short tons to 42,973 short tons Friday.
COMEX July copper prices saw a contract high last week at 120.40, after ongoing fund and trade buying with world refined copper inventories down to only about three weeks worth of demand.
